_: THE GIFT (GDD 6). A coal core two levels down that fracturing exposes BEFORE it can be reached. You can see the coal and must work for it.
_one_line: The core is ONE override. It changes only the drop -- so at size 4 the core behaves exactly like its siblings and is revealed along with them (GDD 4.6.4), and its coal only materialises at size 2 where the terminal rule fires.
_contrast: Contrast the hidden core of GDD 4.6.3, which is TERMINAL: it never subdivides, so no fracture can ever depict its interior. That one you can tell is there and cannot identify. This one you can read.
